recipes.name: Steamed sea bass with ginger and spring onion

steps.instruction: Set a steamer, or a colander covered with a lid, over a pan of simmering water.
Lay {{ing:sea-bass-fillet}} on a heatproof plate that fits inside.
Scatter over {{ing:ginger-fresh}}, {{ing:spring-onion}} and {{ing:soy-sauce}}, sliced as needed.
Steam 8 minutes, until cooked through.
Finish with {{ing:sesame-oil}}.

recipes.name: Steamed golden syrup sponge
recipes.method_note: Keep the water simmering, never boiling dry.

steps.instruction: Butter a 1 litre pudding basin.
Put {{ing:golden-syrup}} in the bottom, chopped or zested as needed.
Beat {{ing:butter-unsalted}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}} and {{ing:egg-medium}} until pale. Fold in {{ing:flour-self-raising}} and {{ing:milk-whole}}.
Spoon into the basin. Cover with baking paper and foil, pleated to let it rise.
Set a steamer, or a colander covered with a lid, over a pan of simmering water.
Steam 1 hour 30 minutes, topping up the water, until risen and springy.

recipes.name: Spotted dick
recipes.method_note: Keep the water simmering, never boiling dry.

steps.instruction: Mix {{ing:flour-self-raising}}, {{ing:suet-vegetable}}, {{ing:sugar-caster}}, {{ing:currants}} and the zest of {{ing:lemon}}.
Stir in {{ing:milk-whole}} to a soft dough. Shape into a log.
Wrap loosely in baking paper, then foil, with a pleat for it to rise.
Set a steamer, or a colander covered with a lid, over a pan of simmering water.
Steam 1 hour 30 minutes, topping up the water.
